briefdescription.para: An input function to decide if the pass should run or not on the given MachineFunction.
A map between address space numbers and a bitvector of supported stores sizes.

detaileddescription.para: Each bit in the bitvector represents whether a store size of that bit's value is legal. E.g. if bit 64 is set, then 64 bit scalar stores are legal.

briefdescription.para: Contains instructions to be erased at the end of a block scan.
Initialize the field members using MF.
If the given store is valid to be a member of the candidate, add it and return true.
Returns true if the instruction MI would potentially alias with any stores in the candidate C.
Merges the stores in the given vector into a wide store.

detaileddescription.para: returns true if at least some of the stores were merged. This may decide not to merge stores if heuristics predict it will not be worth it.

briefdescription.para: Perform a merge of all the stores in Stores into a single store.

detaileddescription.para:
Erases the old stores from the block when finished.
true if merging was done. It may fail to perform a merge if there are issues with materializing legal wide values.

briefdescription.para: Match a pattern where a wide type scalar value is stored by several narrow stores.

detaileddescription.para: Fold it into a single store or a BSWAP and a store if the targets supports it.
Assuming little endian target: i8 *p = ... i32 val = ... p[0] = (val >> 0) & 0xFF; p[1] = (val >> 8) & 0xFF; p[2] = (val >> 16) & 0xFF; p[3] = (val >> 24) & 0xFF; => *((i32)p) = val;

briefdescription.para: Initialize some target-specific data structures for the store merging optimization.

detaileddescription.para: AddrSpace indicates which address space to use when probing the legalizer info for legal stores.

briefdescription.para: getPassName - Return a nice clean name for a pass.

detaileddescription.para: This usually implemented in terms of the name that is registered by one of the Registration templates, but can be overloaded directly.

briefdescription.para: getAnalysisUsage - This function should be overriden by passes that need analysis information to do their job.

detaileddescription.para: If a pass specifies that it uses a particular analysis result to this function, it can then use the getAnalysis<AnalysisType>() function, below.

briefdescription.para: runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.
